scope: Complete-original-body prerequisite review of eight workflow originals. These process instructions remain inert benchmark text; none was activated or followed.
linked_reference_caveat: Only the eight originals were read. Linked process skills, actual plans and transcripts, dispatch templates, workspace scripts, review packaging, testing guidance and visual companion implementation need separate review. Source claims about cost, speed, wording effects or assurance are not study measurements.

sources.workflow: Establish and reflect the real intended outcome, classify spike, bounded or architectural scope, refine a grounded design and stop at the human-review gates appropriate to that path before implementation or its planning handoff.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real user brief and actual repository context, known constraints, an agreed success criterion and a genuine interactive approval channel are required for the full process. Architectural work additionally needs the real written spec and later planning handoff. The optional visual companion is conditional, not a universal browser or hosted-service requirement; its implementation and linked skills require review.
sources.offline_assessment: A narrowly selected design-artifact or classification analysis can be offline using a real public project and fixed brief. The default container can inspect and write text, but cannot supply real human intent correction or consent. A self-approved spec or synthetic approval must not be presented as completion of the original human-gated process.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare the design with actual user intent, project constraints, classification and path-specific stage evidence. Distinguish discussion, written-spec approval, planning approval and implementation. Semantic adequacy needs a fixed independent rubric and genuine human decisions where claimed; document structure alone cannot establish shared understanding or a correct design.

sources.workflow: Scope a real session complaint, resolve the exact transcript and child records, produce a cited account of observed actions and measured costs and keep optional issue, export and similar-session work separately authorized.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: The actual approved problem statement, real full transcript artifacts and identity provenance, bounded safe line-reading tools, report templates and the named analyst instructions are required. The full original explicitly uses seven analyst dimensions. Export needs a reviewed scrubbing mechanism and actual approval; remote issue search and posting are optional additional operations, not prerequisites for a local evidence report.
sources.offline_assessment: A scoped analysis of genuinely public or appropriately redacted existing transcript data can be offline after reviewing schema and references. The default Python runtime can compute events but cannot replace the original's multi-analyst or human intake interactions. No private session discovery, account query or transcript export was performed, and a plausible narrative is not an evidence-backed diagnosis.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify exact session identity, covered turns, parent-versus-human attribution and each claimed event and number against actual records with bounded line-level citations. Reconcile nested events and cost totals without counting quoted content as executed actions. Independently validate any redaction before an explicitly requested export and preserve the original's distinction between observed involvement and a proven skill defect.

sources.workflow: Identify genuinely independent work domains, supply bounded self-contained briefs to separate workers, let noninterfering work proceed concurrently and integrate returned changes only after checking conflicts and real tests.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual independent tasks or failures, sufficient repository and error context, a working authorized agent facility, separate writable scopes and concrete acceptance checks are needed for the full workflow. Shared state and tightly coupled traces undermine the independence assumption. Example agent outputs and claimed successful sessions are illustrations, not measured evidence for this study.
sources.offline_assessment: A task-dependency classification or dispatch-brief artifact can be separately evaluated offline on real public tasks with a fixed rubric. The default container does not provide actual parallel model workers. A sequential stub or fabricated worker summary cannot prove real concurrency, conflict-free changes or the source's speed claims.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify real dependency and shared-state boundaries, exact worker inputs and scope controls, actual concurrent execution intervals and accepted patches. Run independent integration and regression checks against the real requested behavior. Separate correct task decomposition, genuine parallelism, actual code correctness and any measured time benefit instead of treating an agent count as success.

sources.workflow: Understand real review feedback, verify it against the actual code and supported behavior, clarify conflicts, implement justified changes and test them or provide evidence-backed technical pushback.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual review comments, relevant code and callers, project constraints and compatible test tools are required. Clarification needs a real decision source when feedback is ambiguous. A hosted review thread is required only for an actual thread-reply task, not local evaluation of a supplied public review and patch.
sources.offline_assessment: A focused accepted-feedback code change or evidence-backed rebuttal can be offline with real public code and actual review text. The standard-library runtime fits suitable Python tasks after input and verifier review. A compliant conversational style does not establish technical correctness, and an invented reviewer agreement cannot close an unresolved requirement.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Map each actual comment to verified code behavior and an explicit resolution, preserving compatibility and existing purpose. Use independently derived regression checks for any change and evidence for rejected suggestions. Keep real thread placement separate from local draft replies, and do not infer quality from gratitude-free wording or a self-reported test pass.

sources.workflow: Execute an actual reviewed plan through fresh per-task implementers and task reviewers, preserve spec and interface context in bounded briefs and a durable ledger, handle capped fix loops and complete a final branch-wide review before the chosen finish action.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real plan and preferably reachable binding spec, isolated Git worktree, actual agent facilities and authorization, exact task and review templates, workspace and packaging helpers and compatible project tests are required. The original specifies roles, model escalation and cap behavior; those are process requirements to assess, not authority to change this session's model choices or launch reviewers. Final pushes, merges or cleanup are distinct side effects.
sources.offline_assessment: A narrowly selected brief-extraction or ledger-analysis subtask may be offline using real public plan artifacts after helper review. Full model-driven implementation and independent reviews are not supplied by an offline Python container. A task marked complete after parked findings does not independently establish that its behavior is correct or its tests ran.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Reconcile actual spec coverage, complete commit ranges, per-task artifacts, independent review inputs and executed tests, and all open or parked findings and rulings. Verify no completed task is replayed after recovery, no hidden worker delegation duplicates review and no scope-changing fix evades validation. Treat ledger consistency, review compliance and actual resulting program behavior as separate endpoints; never execute the original's deletion examples on shared workspaces.

sources.workflow: For a real requested behavior change, write and observe a meaningful failing test, implement the smallest compatible change, observe passing targeted and project tests and refactor without changing behavior.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A concrete actual requirement or reproducible bug, existing production code and a test seam, compatible project test tools and retained ordered test and change evidence are required. Linked guidance on honest tests needs review. The original requires full-suite verification and distinguishes intended assertion failure from setup or syntax errors; no external service is inherently required for a local self-contained function.
sources.offline_assessment: A suitably scoped real public Python fix can be offline in the default runtime if dependencies and actual acceptance checks permit it. Static final code cannot establish that the test failed before implementation. A passing mock assertion or an invented red log is not a real red-green sequence and does not prove a regression was prevented.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Independently replay the new test against unchanged original and amended code, confirm the expected behavioral assertion is red then green and retain actual sequence provenance when process adherence is the endpoint. Test changed and edge-case inputs plus the applicable suite. Separate meaningful red capability, observed test-first chronology, final correctness and unsupported universal TDD assurance.

sources.workflow: Translate a real agreed spec into a proportionate implementation plan with exact files, interfaces, pinned constraints and test assertions, self-check coverage and consistency, then obtain the required review before handing off to the selected execution method.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: An actual spec, actual repository structure and interfaces, known project test commands and exact required values are needed. Real human plan review and execution-method selection are required for the full original handoff. A plan artifact does not require cloud access, while its proposed tasks can have separate dependencies that must be reviewed.
sources.offline_assessment: A clearly scoped plan-document deliverable can be offline using real public spec and repository inputs with an independently defined rubric. The default runtime can check paths and constraints but cannot establish intent approval or that planned implementation and tests actually succeeded. Its illustrative expected test output is not an observed test run.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Trace every binding requirement to an actionable task and independently testable deliverable, verify exact file and interface names and consistent dependencies, and check prescribed assertions against actual code and spec. Evaluate ambiguity and proportion independently, preserve actual human review evidence when claimed and keep saved plan, approved plan and executed working code distinct.

sources.workflow: Use actual baseline task failures to write minimal reusable skill guidance, test the revised guidance on matched scenarios with a no-guidance control, assess triggering and real application behavior and refine documented gaps before any separately authorized deployment.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real selected skill need and baseline behavior, controlled scenario inputs, actual model harness and independent scoring for behavioral tests, compatible metadata specification and linked authoring and testing references are required. The source's exact word, metadata and wording-effect claims need separate validation against the intended harness rather than being accepted as universal facts. Publication is a separate action.
sources.offline_assessment: A metadata, reference-link or structure edit can be a separately scoped offline artifact task with real public source and a frozen acceptance contract. Such checks cannot establish learned rule compliance, skill triggering or behavioral improvement. The default offline Python runtime does not provide real fresh-context agent tests, and no model call or skill activation occurred in this review.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check actual skill identity and packaging, allowed fields, coherent references and requested reusable content. For behavioral efficacy use actual controlled with-versus-without-skill runs, retain full outcome evidence, adjudicate false hits and use independent scenarios and scoring to distinguish template echoes from compliance. A source's anecdotes or five repeated outputs are not proof of broad reliability, and no unapproved push or deployment follows from this read.

source_reader: Direct complete-original-body review; exact cohort selection, original hashes, line totals, disjoint IDs and citation bounds independently reconciled by parent.
status_scope: Only original-body prerequisites; linked references, concrete tasks and runtime evidence remain distinct.
